observations: A portable water well drilling rig with a red-painted steel mast and base.
A small gasoline engine is mounted on a sliding carriage on the mast.
A green reduction gearbox is connected to the engine.
A water pump with 'TIGER' printed on the side is in the foreground (photo 0).
A yellow bucket with 'MAGGI' branding is visible (photo 0).
One drill pipe is attached to the rig and inserted into the ground.
A yellow plastic jerrycan and various hoses/pipes are scattered on the ground.
The setup is located outdoors on unpaved ground.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the mast, engine, and drill assembly characteristic of a portable rig.
The photo does not show the inventory of drill pipes necessary to reach the claimed depth.

Close-up photos of all drill bits included.
